g.text: # Celebrity Radar — Shah Rukh Khan
Incidents, Legal & Controversy
Vimal Elaichi surrogate advertising notices (Aug 2026):
Maharashtra FDA issued show‑cause notices to Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Tiger Shroff over alleged surrogate
advertising of a prohibited pan masala brand; actors asked to remove promotions and respond. The FDA
commissioner said responses were received and two hearings held. Status: pending outcome; no final order
reported in sources (Indian Express; Moneycontrol; PTI; Bollywood Hungama; Times of India).
Mannat renovation case (Jul 2026):
Supreme Court dismissed the plea against CRZ clearance for adding two floors to Khan’s Mumbai home; the
NGT’s Sep 2025 order upholding clearance stands. Status: renovation can proceed; case closed at SC
(Indian Express; LiveLaw).
KKR/Mustafizur Rahman controversy (Jan 2026):
Backlash after KKR (owned by Khan) bought Bangladesh pacer Mustafizur Rahman at the IPL 2026 auction; on
Jan 3, KKR were instructed to exclude the player, who was then released. Status: player released;
controversy subsided (India Today; Moneycontrol; Wisden).
Hyundai complaint FIR (Sep 2025):
Rajasthan High Court stayed investigation into an FIR naming Khan and Deepika Padukone as Hyundai
ambassadors over an allegedly “defective” car; court suggested mediation. Status: investigation stayed;
relief granted (SCC Online; Times of India).
Threat/extortion FIR (Nov 7, 2024):
Mumbai Police registered an FIR after a caller issued death threats and demanded Rs 50 lakh from Khan.
Status: FIR lodged; probe initiated (Indian Express).
Health incident (May 22–23, 2024):
Hospitalized for heat stroke/dehydration in Ahmedabad during an IPL match; discharged the next day.
Status: recovered (NDTV; Hindustan Times).
